source: Smithers modules the platform split refused because a kept statement above an export ran moved code while the module loaded, although that code never read the export: build/targets Exec.ts (a schema above the copied defaultPathExtensions reads the moved Payload) and build/targets ToolBuild.ts (a kept value above the re-exported CapturePayload reads moved Options). Also LlmLint.ts, GeneratedFile.ts, Cli.ts, PackagePlanner.ts and flows/examples sandboxed-child.ts. Minimized; shapes kept.
